description: Live position of the International Space Station: latitude, longitude, altitude, orbital velocity and whether it's currently in daylight — fetched the moment you call. A genuinely live fact no model can know, ideal for demos and tracking automations. Use this when an agent needs to where the International Space Station is right now. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
